steps: Tell us what's going on. We book a 2-hour arrival window and text you when the tech is on the way.
The tech finds the cause and gives you written options with prices. Nothing starts until you approve.
We do the work, test it with you, and leave the space clean. You get the invoice and warranty by email.

faq: Do you charge to come out?
There is a diagnostic fee for repair visits, and it is credited toward the repair if you go ahead. Estimates for a new system or water heater are free. (Sample terms for this demo.)
Do you offer emergency service at night and on weekends?
Yes. Call any time and a dispatcher answers. After-hours rates apply and are explained on the phone before we send a tech.
Yes. We hold a Texas ACR contractor license and a Texas master plumber license, and we carry general liability and workers' comp insurance. License numbers are listed on our About page.
Houston and nearby cities including Bellaire, West University Place, Pearland, Sugar Land and Katy. Not sure about your address? Text us your ZIP code.
Do you work on all brands?
Yes. We repair all major AC, furnace and water heater brands. For new systems we will recommend a few options at different price points.
Financing is available on new systems and water heaters, subject to credit approval. Ask the tech or the office for current plans.
Repairs carry a labor warranty and parts carry the manufacturer warranty. The exact terms are printed on your invoice.
A pipe burst. What do I do first?

Turn off the main water shut-off (often near the street or where the line enters the house), switch off the water heater, then call us. If water is near outlets, keep clear and switch off that circuit at the breaker if it is safe to reach.

story: Ray Medina started Copperleaf in 2009 with one truck and an AC license. His wife Dolores ran the phones from the kitchen table. A few years later we added a master plumber, because customers kept asking us to look at the water heater while we were there.
Today we run a small team of licensed techs across the Houston area. Every truck carries AC and plumbing parts, so most jobs are finished in one visit.
We still answer the phone ourselves, and we still give you the price before we pick up a tool.
values: Written options with prices. You choose, then we start.
We show you the worn part or the camera footage, not just a diagnosis.
Shoe covers, drop cloths, and we take the old equipment with us.
